title: IBRANCE (palbociclib) PALOMA Program: Reading the Pivotal Trial Numbers

questions.caption: Median investigator-assessed progression-free survival in PALOMA-2 (first-line, postmenopausal HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer, n=666), primary analysis, from the NEJM primary publication.
questions.prompt: According to the chart, what is the absolute difference in median PFS between the palbociclib plus letrozole arm and the letrozole-alone arm in PALOMA-2?
questions.rationale: The chart shows median PFS of 24.8 months with palbociclib plus letrozole versus 14.5 months with placebo plus letrozole; the absolute difference is 24.8 \=. Answer (b) is simply the control-arm value, (c) is the treatment-arm value, and (d) is the PALOMA-3 updated (non-prespecified) PFS difference, not the PALOMA-2 figure shown here.

citations.title: Palbociclib and Letrozole in Advanced Breast Cancer | NEJM

questions.caption: Median PFS in PALOMA-3 (post-endocrine-therapy progression, HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer, n=521), primary analysis supporting FDA approval of palbociclib plus fulvestrant.
questions.prompt: What was the median PFS improvement (in months) with palbociclib plus fulvestrant compared with placebo plus fulvestrant in the PALOMA-3 primary analysis shown here?
questions.rationale: The chart shows 9.5 months with palbociclib plus fulvestrant versus 4.6 months with placebo plus fulvestrant; the difference is 4.9 months (HR 0.46). Options (b) and (c) restate single arm values rather than the difference, and (d) is the 6.6-month difference from a later, non-prespecified updated PFS analysis of PALOMA-3, not the primary analysis plotted here.
